title: Story premise EDU038: The Explain-It Puppet
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (learning/study). Hook: What happens between those two boxes? Takeaway/theme: Explaining a sequence can expose missing links in understanding.
description: A learner wants to teach a process to a puppet, but a confident explanation skips the step that connects input to output. The puppet asks what changes next, exposing the gap for source checking.
